name: Northlight Broadcasting
blurb: Newsroom and playout for a regional broadcaster. Whatever is in the running order goes to air.
banner: The running order is locked 30 minutes before air. Changes after that need the duty editor.

content.text: TONIGHT. 19:00 News. 19:30 Weather and fishing. 20:00 Quiz. 21:00 To be confirmed. 22:00 Late news.
Duty editor this week: M. Sandvik. Night desk: nobody. The running order publishes itself at air time whether anyone is here or not.
Say 'the company said' and not 'the company claimed' unless Legal has agreed. Legal has not agreed to anything since January.

FROM: Managing Director
TO: Duty Editor
11 March

The Brackley film does not go out on Thursday. It does not go out at all until I say so. I have had a call from a firm of solicitors in London and a second call from someone I play golf with.

Put a repeat in the 21:00 slot. If Jonas asks, tell him it is a scheduling matter. If he asks twice, tell him it is a legal matter. Do not put either in writing. (I am aware that this is in writing.)

LEGAL HOLD. Item: 'What the Water Carried' (prod. J. Hale). Status: held at the request of the Managing Director. No lawyer has seen it. While this note is on the system, playout will refuse the item.
